verdicts.paper_text: Proposition 1.8 (1.6). Let $(N; \partial N)$ be obtained from the sphere $S^2$ by removing a finite number $s$ of open discs: $(N; \partial N) = (S^2 \setminus \bigcup_{i=1}^{s} D_i^2; \bigcup_{i=1}^{s} S_i^1)$, and let $(L; \partial L)$ be obtained from the projective plane $\mathbb{R}P^2$ by removing a finite number $k$ of open discs: $(L; \partial L) = (\mathbb{R}P^2 \setminus \bigcup_{i=1}^{k} D_i^2; \bigcup_{i=1}^{k} S_i^1)$. For $p = 0$ the $p$-length of a two-dimensional compact connected manifold equals: 1. one, if the manifold is homeomorphic to $(N; \partial N)$, to $(L; \partial L)$, or to the sphere $S^2$; 2. two, on the other manifolds. For $p = 1$ the $p$-length of a two-dimensional compact connected manifold equals: 1. zero, if the manifold is homeomorphic to the sphere $S^2$ or to the disc $D^2$; 2. one, on the other manifolds.
